text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out with Yukino Bijin.
Wondering if any work messages had come in, I found myself glancing at my smartphone, when...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aya? Did something happen?
Were you really busy today after all?
choice_data_list: Sorry, I was just curious, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Worried about your phone? Hmph, Trainer, even on your day off, your mind isn't resting at all, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about I hold onto
your smartphone today?
You know, like a "digital detox" thing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Digital detox" refers to taking a short break from the internet.
I believe it's supposed to help reduce stress for busy people in modern society...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Then let's spend today
"relaxing" as much as we can.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Relax, relax... Let's see now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, how about we try checkin' out that place over there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And the place she brought me to
was a planetarium.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...♪ Actually, I heard they're screening
something based on Morioka nursery rhymes today,
so I was thinkin' I'd like to check it out.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I used to sing it a lot when I was little.
'The scorpion with red, glowing eyes~♪' ...or something like that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin softly hummed the lyrics
written in the brochure for me...
It was a beautiful, catchy melody.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back. We'd climb up onto the roof as a family,
singin' songs while searchin' for stars..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's starting... hehehe...
Well then, time for a journey through the stars...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In time with the gentle music,
the stars from the song twinkle...
Scorpius, Aquila, Canis Minor...

—High above, Orion sings...♪
—Shedding dew and frost alike...♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —The guiding mark of the heavenly skies...♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "...The stars are so beautiful. Come, let's go much, much further... and see so many more things!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even farther...
The world is wide, and the dream is grand...
The road to get there is still very long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the vast starry sky makes me think...
Being born in the same era, on the same planet,
and meeting her is a matter of astronomical odds...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two people who crossed paths in this vast world,
now chasing the very same dream together.
That is, truly――

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—*Sigh*~~ It sure was purty, don'tcha think?
The world of the stars really is endin'less, huh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Meeting you in a universe this vast,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but think... it was a "miracle"...
choice_data_list: I was thinking the same thing...
I was thinking the same thing...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but think... it was a "miracle"...
choice_data_list: I was thinking the same thing...
I was thinking the same thing...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gyah? It's true, though... Are you really that surprised?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, our meeting each other
is what you'd call an 'astronomical probability'!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Are you laughing at me?!
Did I say something weird?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"M-Miracle" and all... is that an exaggeration,
or was it too "dramatic"...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still though... I really,
truly thought so...
choice_data_list: Sorry, sorry. Actually, the thing is—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, today was so much fun.
And to think... we were both thinking the exact same thing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin laughs beside me.
As we walked home sharing our thoughts,
a profoundly gentle time drifted by...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right, Trainer... your smartphone!
Should I give it back to you now...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... In that case, would it be alright if I held onto it for a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There's still so much more I want to talk about...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-whaaat!? R-Really...?
Whoa, what a huge coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's strange...
I haven't even told you a single thing...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Even without smartphones and stuff, we somehow just understand each other, don't we?!
choice_data_list: I'd be happy if that were the case.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I'm sure our hearts are connected! We've run together all this way, after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if you'd like,
would you like to watch some other screenings too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Today, I just want to forget about daily life for a bit
and take my time gazing at the stars before heading back...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And with that, the starry sky stretched overhead once more.
Leaving the hectic daily routine behind,
we were able to spend a peaceful, quiet time together...
